description: MECHANISM: a `repeat`'s own count expression sits OUTSIDE its body (issue #1155). `repeat repcount [ … ]` at top level is a fault: the count is evaluated before the turn it would report exists. Measured against the evaluator before the rule was written: this program raised `ol-repcount-outside-repeat` at `runtime` after 1 event. A rule that treated the whole `Repeat` node as enclosing — rather than only its body — would call this program clean, so this fixture is what fails if the count expression is folded into the body context. The companion clean case, `repeat 2 [ repeat repcount [ … ] ]`, is asserted by `packages/parser/src/repcount-outside-repeat.test.mjs` rather than here; note that `core-language/execution/repeat-nested-repcount` does NOT cover it — that fixture is `repeat 2 [ repeat 2 [ print repcount ] ]`, a nested body, not a nested COUNT expression.
